note: Release record for tools/publish.py (RELEASE-01, ADR 0010, docs/PUBLISH.md). One platform repository, OpenCine, holds every shared product and this atlas; it gets one tag. `commit` is what the publish expects on `branch` (the platform may differ from it only under atlas/); `evidence` says where the green run at that commit is recorded. `verify` runs in a clean clone ({base} is the remote base); app `resolve` runs in the app worktree to produce `lockfiles`. Decisions stay null until the user records them with `tools/publish.py decide`.
